correctness.rationale: Li--Zeng's companion-cube decomposition reduces the mean oscillation on a gamma-cube to finitely many logarithmic averages of commutator outputs on translated indicator functions, or on a bounded mean-zero substitute. The normalization is comparable to the cube volume in every dimension. Replacing the final strong norm by the equivalent associate norm of weak L^q preserves Minkowski and gives m_Q |Q|^(1/q) bounded by the weak operator norm times |Q|^(1/p), exactly yielding the BMO^{gamma,alpha} scaling.

originality.rationale: Qualified to the best of our knowledge. Li--Zeng's September 2026 theorem is diagonal L^p-to-L^p. Oikari's 2023 off-diagonal paper proves sufficiency in all dimensions but restricts necessity to the plane and explicitly asks for higher-dimensional necessity. Searches found no all-dimensional L^p-to-weak-L^q necessity statement. The source preprint is very recent, so contemporaneous unindexed coverage remains a residual risk.

value.rationale: The theorem extends off-diagonal necessity from the plane to every dimension and strengthens the target to weak L^q. Together with the known strong sufficiency range, it yields an all-dimensional equivalence between the Campanato condition, strong boundedness, and weak boundedness in that range.

disclaimer: Not independent validation, peer review, formal verification, or a guarantee of first discovery.
